channel.title: The Grant Desk - Audio, Sound & Music, EU, next 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Audio, Sound & Music, EU, next 30 days, weekly digest. One entry per week rounding up everything released that week, instead of one entry per grant.

item.title: 2 new grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:

  • Berlin Senate: Arbeitsstipendium Bildende Kunst 2027 (Berlin residents only)
    Berlin Senate Department for Culture and Social Cohesion · deadline 02 Sep 2026 · EUR 16,000 (8 months) or EUR 24,000 (12 months), paid as EUR 2,000 per month. No application fee.
